The stated final answer of 9 is wrong. The correct answer is 337, which is also what the solution's own derivation reached before it broke off.

The repetend is N = (10^726 − 1)/727, so 727·N = 10^726 − 1 ≡ −1 (mod 1000). That gives N ≡ −727⁻¹ (mod 1000).

The solution found 727⁻¹ ≡ 663 (mod 1000). Check: 727·663 = 482,001 ≡ 1 (mod 1000), so this is correct.

Then N ≡ −663 ≡ 337 (mod 1000). Check: 727·337 = 244,999 ≡ 999 ≡ −1 (mod 1000), which confirms it.

The last three digits of the repetend are therefore 337, not 9. The solution text never reaches 9, and its closing verification degenerates into repeated text without concluding.

VERDICT: REJECT
